description:
Fat Tire Electric Bike
Urban commuting electric bike matches 26x3.0.In addition, the large-capacity 48V 15Ah removable battery provides the bike with a super-long cruising range of more than 20MILE, allowing you to enjoy a relaxing and enjoyable time along the way.
Powerful Electric Bike
This HITWAY ebike for adults is equipped with a 750W high-speed brushless motor, with a top speed of 20MPH. The powerful torque of the brushless motor climbs up to 25-degree slopes effortlessly. Riding on any surface can continue to output strong power on challenging roads, ensuring your excellent off-road riding experience.
Foldable Electric Bike
HITWAY BK12M e-bike is easy to fold and carry in SUV, truck, office home. Whether commuting, weekends or holidays, this electric bike can provide you with a convenient and comfortable riding experience. The bicycle is suitable for teenagers and adults above 163cm.
Innovative Design
This folding electric bicycle is made of strong and durable aluminum alloy material, equipped with Shimano 7-Speed Gear system, which provides more safety instead of wobbling when you ride at high speed. The smart LCD display shows speed, mileage, battery and many other data. There are also excellent fork shock absorbers, front and rear reflectors and LED headlights to help you ride safely.
